title: Add a column while preserving installed data
setup: A released local plugin has an existing table with seeded records. The target is a disposable Moodle database.
prompt: Add a field with a data backfill for previously installed sites.
checks: Update install XML and add a guarded upgrade with a savepoint after success.
Bump the plugin version and preserve existing rows.
Verify fresh-install and prior-release upgrade results.
